Haven't checked it — so no, I can't say it definitely passes.

"Shipping today" doesn't change whether it's true, it just raises the cost of finding out at the wrong time.

To actually verify, I need the real values in front of me: text color + background color (hex/tokens) for body copy, labels, placeholder text, and any disabled/secondary states, plus whatever's being used for borders on inputs/toggles if those matter here. Once I have those I can check them against 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text and controls — those are the floors, not a guess.

If nobody's run that check yet, that's the actual status: unverified, not passing. Worth doing before it ships, not after.
